'''Stasis probes''' were unmanned surveillance [[Probe droid/Legends|probes]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. These probes were capable of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel and were used for surveillance missions deep into hostile enemy territory. They operated by entering [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] for twenty seconds to take a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] snapshot of a target and transmitting the data back to a controller.

During the Black Fleet Crisis, the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] and [[Alpha Blue]] dispatched more than fifty stasis probes into the [[N'zoth system/Legends|N'zoth system]] to monitor and to draw out the [[Duskhan League]] into combat. Probes [[203]], [[239]] and [[252]] were programmed to release [[Cronau radiation/Legends|Cronau radiation]] and transmit radar signals to draw out the [[Yevetha]]n war fleet in preparation for the [[Battle of N'zoth]]. Consequently, these probes were destroyed by the Yevetha.
